changeSet.sql: CREATE or alter VIEW [dbo].[ResponsibilityDetail] AS select r.id as RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, coalesce(RD.ResourceID, RG.ResourceID, rresource.SecurityAssetID) as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, rresource.SecurityAsset, rresource.SecurityAssetID, coalesce(D.Name, G.Name, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName) as SecurityAssetName, r.Context, r.ApplyToType, rrel.PermissionsBitMask, r.IsVisible, orides.ID as OverrideID, A.Object, coalesce(A.ObjectID, 0) as ObjectID, T.Object as [Type], T.ObjectID as TypeID from responsibilitytyperelationrule r inner join ResponsibilityTypeRelation rrel on (r.ResponsibilityTypeID = rrel.ResponsibilityTypeID and r.[Object] = rrel.[ObjectType] and r.ObjectID = rrel.ObjectID) inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) left join [responsibilitytyperelationoverrideitem] orides on (r.ResponsibilityTypeID = orides.ResponsibilityTypeID and rasset.AssetID = orides.AssetID) inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join AssetType T on T.ID = rasset.AssetTypeID left join Asset A on A.ID = rasset.AssetID and A.AssetTypeID = T.ID --( (A.ID = O.AssetID) OR (O.AssetID = 0 and A.AssetTypeID = O.AssetTypeID) ) left join [Group] G on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID left join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID left join [Organization] D on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'O' and D.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID left join OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = coalesce(RD.ResourceID, RG.ResourceID, rresource.SecurityAssetID) where orides.id is null and RES.State=1
changeSet.rollback: CREATE or ALTER VIEW [dbo].[ResponsibilityDetail] AS select O.RuleID, O.ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, O.AssetID, O.AssetTypeID, coalesce(RD.ResourceID, RG.ResourceID, O.SecurityAssetID) as ResourceID, R.FirstName + ' ' + R.LastName as ResourceName, O.SecurityAsset, O.SecurityAssetID, coalesce(D.Name, G.Name, R.FirstName + ' ' + R.LastName) as SecurityAssetName, O.Context, O.ApplyToType, O.PermissionsBitMask, O.IsVisible, O.OverrideID, A.Object, coalesce(A.ObjectID, 0) as ObjectID, T.Object as [Type], T.ObjectID as TypeID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult O inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = O.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join AssetType T on T.ID = O.AssetTypeID left join Asset A on A.ID = O.AssetID and A.AssetTypeID = T.ID --( (A.ID = O.AssetID) OR (O.AssetID = 0 and A.AssetTypeID = O.AssetTypeID) ) left join [Group] G on O.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = O.SecurityAssetID left join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID left join [Organization] D on O.SecurityAsset = 'O' and D.ID = O.SecurityAssetID left join OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource R on R.ResourceID = coalesce(RD.ResourceID, RG.ResourceID, O.SecurityAssetID) where O.Overridden = 0 and R.State=1

CREATE or alter FUNCTION AssetsByTypeUserCantRead ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select A.ID as AssetID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] R on (RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID and RR.ObjectType = R.[Object] and RR.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[AssetType] Ast on (Ast.[Object] = R.[Object] and Ast.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[Asset] A on (A.AssetTypeID = Ast.ID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.assettypeid = -1 and rasset.AssetID = A.ID and rasset.ruleid = r.id) where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and Ast.ID = @AssetTypeID and ( exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' and rresource.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Organization] D on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'O' and D.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RD.ResourceID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID ) ) and not exists (select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride where oride.AssetID = A.ID and oride.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID)
)

changeSet.sql:
CREATE or alter FUNCTION AssetTypesUserCantRead ( @ResourceID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select Ast.ID as AssetTypeID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] R on (RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID and RR.ObjectType = R.[Object] and RR.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[AssetType] Ast on (Ast.[Object] = R.[Object] and Ast.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.assetid = -1 and rasset.AssetTypeID = Ast.ID and rasset.ruleid = r.id) where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' and rresource.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Organization] D on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'O' and D.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RD.ResourceID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID )
)
